question: What effect on death by aging is produced through abstention from food by day?
premises: The practice involves not eating during the day
The verse names death by aging as the target
inference: Through daytime abstention from food, one will go beyond death by aging
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is contextually interpreted as overcoming or passing beyond
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death by aging.
